A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the IASI SOFRID ozone profile retrieval algorithm has been improved by using a priori profile that better matches the tropopause height and the vertical distribution of ozone in the tropopause region.
the IASI SOFRID ozone retrieval system has been developed, validated and is now ready for operational use.

we have shown the feasibility of the SOFRID ozone retrieval approach, which has been developed in the last decade, and we have demonstrated that the SOFRID approach can be used with a climatological a-priori profile.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the tropopause is not the only source of uncertainty in ozone retrievals.
the tropopause height is not a constant value but varies in time and space and is not the same for different seasons.
the tropopause height is a key parameter in determining the accuracy of ozone profiles retrieved from the IASI instrument.
